description: Mark the Wi-Fi passphrase sensitive so it decodes as Redacted. The spec documents `passphrase` as the WPA2/WPA3 personal pre-shared key of a Wi-Fi broadcast (WPA2, WPA3 and WPA2/WPA3 security configurations, and the per-network preshared keys), but its name does not match convert's default sensitive patterns. Source: the published UniFi Network 11.0.97 OpenAPI document. Where a member has no traits yet, a `test` first asserts it is a bare string, so the `traits` object this adds never replaces traits a newer spec gives it.
